name: FFmpeg Fade And Fontsize Pop Envelope
use_when: A simple FFmpeg title or keyword needs a fade-in, fade-out, pop, or small bounce.
The effect can be expressed through opacity and font-size changes.
The agent needs a lightweight approximation of a CapCut/Premiere text pop.
avoid_when: The text needs exact transform scale, non-uniform stretch, masks, or spring physics.
Changing font size would cause line wrapping, cropping, or layout drift.
The project tone would be better served by stable text.

timeline_pattern.pattern: drawtext_layer -> start_time -> fade_in_or_pop_duration -> hold -> optional_fade_out -> clear
timeline_pattern.fade_rule: Divide alpha into hidden, fade-in, hold, fade-out, and hidden phases.
timeline_pattern.pop_rule: Normalize time over the entrance window and map progress into font size.
timeline_pattern.center_rule: Recompute centered x/y from text dimensions so animated size does not drift.

motion.rule: Use short envelopes that land before the viewer needs to read the word.

keyframe_values.fade_duration: About 0.3 seconds works as a calm title starting point; shorten for fast shorts.
keyframe_values.pop_start: A pop can begin around 70 percent of final font size.
keyframe_values.pop_peak: A bounce can peak around 110 percent before settling to final size.
keyframe_values.sync_tolerance: For emphasis beats, the pop should land within about 2 frames of the intended audio or visual cue.

sound.rule: Use a small pop/click only when the text is a real emphasis beat and speech remains dominant.

captions.rule: Do not use font-size pop on accessibility-first subtitles unless it has passed readability and timing QC.

color.rule: Maintain enough contrast through the smallest and largest font-size states.

implementation.ffmpeg: Animate drawtext alpha for fade envelopes and fontsize for pop/bounce; keep x/y tied to text dimensions during animated size changes.
implementation.remotion: Prefer transform scale and spring/interpolate progress for reusable versions; use the FFmpeg values as approximation references.
implementation.blender: Animate text object opacity and scale with eased curves.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Use opacity keyframes for fade and scale keyframes or a pop preset for size entrance.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use Transform scale and opacity keyframes or a saved text pop preset.

common_mistakes: Letting a fade begin too late so the viewer cannot read the word in time.
Using animated font size on multi-line text that rewraps or drifts.
Overshooting until text collides with safe margins.
Adding pop motion to every caption line.
Testing only the hold frame and missing the smallest or largest state.
qc: Text remains centered through the size animation.
The entrance finishes before the word needs to be read.
Overshoot does not crop or collide with faces/proof/UI/captions.
The smallest and largest states preserve contrast.
Any pop/click cue stays below speech and lands on the visual.
